answer_1.quote: To facilitate effective conversation understanding and generation, we propose an entity‑aware neural conversational model for medical dialog generation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models on test set, using the following standard metrics. The BLEU score computes the amount of word overlap with the words from the ground truth response. ROUGE‑L measures the longest matching sequence of words. Perplexity (PPL) is computed... We also compute unigram F1‑score... Embedding‑based metrics such as Greedy Matching, Vector Extrema and Embedding Average are an alternative to word‑matching‑based metrics.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the quality of generated responses from a human point of view, we randomly select 50 dialogs... three human evaluators... also had our model outputs validated by a doctor... The scale runs from 1 to 5. (i) Fluency, (ii) Adequacy, (iii) Entity Relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters (post‑graduates and a doctor) rated each response on fluency, adequacy, and entity relevance using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
